name: k8s-debug-check-namespace
title: ship k8s-debug check_namespace v1.0
description: Single-namespace health snapshot: pods(Running/CrashLoop/Pending/Failed counts) + recent Warning+ events + deployments(stuck rollouts) + services(empty endpoints) + pvcs(pending). Domain-scored summary (ok/warn/crit) + top-3 findings. Reuses diagnose_pod's kubectl wrapper lib.
